units.source_text: “来，”阿泷从睡铺上坐起身来，把阿雪搂在怀里，“阿雪，你应该放聪明点，不是吗……

en.t: Otaki sat up from the bedding and held Ayuki in her arms.
Ayuki, you should be a little wiser, shouldn't you...

units.source_text: 从前我想方设法保护你，让你有朝一日凭着它发迹，没想到竟让仓吉这个畜生……

en.t: All this time I did everything I could to protect you, hoping that one day you could use it to get ahead, but then that brute Kurakichi...

units.source_text: 阿雪，你要是迷上仓吉这号男人可就糟啰。

en.t: Ayuki, if you fall for a man like Kurakichi, you will be in real trouble.

units.source_text: 你得赶紧另找一个，管他是谁。

en.t: You need to hurry and find someone else, no matter who he is.

units.source_text: 真的，倘使被一个人迷住，那是女人的失败啊。

en.t: Truly, if a woman lets herself be bewitched by one man, that is her defeat.

units.source_text: 要是输给那号男人就完蛋了……

en.t: If you lose to that sort of man, it is all over...
No, I have nothing to regret...
If it truly doesn't matter, then that is fine.

units.source_text: 阿雪，如果你不赶紧另找一个，可就要吃大亏呀。”

en.t: Ayuki, if you don't hurry and find someone else, you will pay dearly.
